paper_title: Continual Dialogue State Tracking via Reason-of-Select Distillation
caption: : Avg. JGA score at each turn
model_annotation: The chart illustrates the average Joint Goal Accuracy (Avg. JGA) score at each dialogue turn for two models, comparing their per-turn scores across a sequence of turn IDs. The horizontal axis contains the categories and is labeled “Turn ID,” showing discrete turn values in ascending order from 0 to 26 in steps of 2 (0, 2, 4, …, 26). The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Avg. JGA Score,” displayed on a linear scale with labeled ticks from 0.2 up to 1.0 at regular 0.1 intervals. For each turn ID, there are two adjacent (grouped) vertical bars: an orange bar for “LLaMA-7B” and a yellow bar for “T5-small,” as indicated by the legend in the upper-right of the plot. Approximate bar heights by turn are: Turn 0 (LLaMA-7B ≈ 0.96, T5-small ≈ 0.95), Turn 2 (≈ 0.92, ≈ 0.84), Turn 4 (≈ 0.88, ≈ 0.71), Turn 6 (≈ 0.83, ≈ 0.61), Turn 8 (≈ 0.77, ≈ 0.58), Turn 10 (≈ 0.75, ≈ 0.51), Turn 12 (≈ 0.73, ≈ 0.46), Turn 14 (≈ 0.69, ≈ 0.48), Turn 16 (≈ 0.67, ≈ 0.47), Turn 18 (≈ 0.61, ≈ 0.48), Turn 20 (≈ 0.65, ≈ 0.43), Turn 22 (≈ 0.60, ≈ 0.42), Turn 24 (≈ 0.64, ≈ 0.30), and Turn 26 (≈ 0.44, ≈ 0.33). The bars are not additionally annotated or visually emphasized beyond the consistent color coding and side-by-side grouping for each turn.
